title: Cloud observability + SLO target — measured SLOs, OpenTelemetry, burn-rate gating for the cloud-* substrate
purpose: Target spec for the observability + SLO substrate that gates production-100 (P-DEFINE slo_exit). Every cloud-* service + control-plane operation emits OpenTelemetry traces/metrics/logs and declares measured SLOs; promotion is SLO-gated (ADR-0130). Honest non-claim: target spec; no collector, SLO engine, dashboards, or measured SLO evidence is implemented here.

telemetry.standard: OpenTelemetry SDK (traces + metrics + logs); OTLP export to the observability substrate
telemetry.per_resource: control-plane operations + per-resource lifecycle emit spans + audit-chain correlation (ADR-0263)

slo_model.authoring: microservices/<ms>/slos/*.openslo.yaml mandatory before any service promotes past dev (ADR-0130/0131)
slo_model.targets: per-service availability (>=99.9% measured at 100) + latency objectives per manifest (ADR-0340); multi-region objectives for the hyperscale bar
slo_model.error_budget: burn-rate alerting; brown-out degradation signal (specs/brownout-degradation-signal.json) before SLO breach

slo_gated_promotion.model: agentic SLO-gated promotion (specs/agentic-slo-gated-promotion.json): a service/resource promotes dev->staging->prod only when its SLO evidence window is green
slo_gated_promotion.ci_cd: wired into ArgoCD progressive delivery (canary -> bake-time SLO observation -> automatic metric-gated rollback, ADR-0349) and the promotion workflows

dr_observability: RTO/RPO matrix (ADR-0343) instrumented; failover drills emit measured recovery-time/point evidence (not declared).
cost_observability: FinOps per-tenant cost attribution + OpenCost/FOCUS export (ADR-0344) as first-class observability dimensions.
non_claims: Target spec only — references agentic-slo-gated-promotion + brownout schemas; does not implement the OTel collector, SLO engine, burn-rate alerting, dashboards, or promotion runtime.
No measured SLO/DR/cost evidence; availability/latency/recovery claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.

cloud-observability.required_truth: The cloud-observability directory may exist for foundation/contract code, but directory presence must not be read as an OTel collector, SLO engine, dashboard, measured-evidence, or production-readiness claim.
